note: CaixaBank's fee information document (17 September 2025): the Cuenta On-line CaixaBank, with its account's keeping and administration and one debit card, costs nothing a year. Read again 2026-10-30 (the document of 17 September 2025): SEPA transfers in euros cost nothing; one outside SEPA in another currency 0.6% at least 15.00 EUR with shared costs (0.7% at least 27.00 EUR with the sender paying all), plus 2.5% over the market rate on the conversion, not held; CaixaBank's own machines are free, another bank's charge the machine owner's fee in full; a tacit overdraft carries 0.00% interest but a 0.20% opening commission on the amount and 40.00 EUR for each claim of a debit position, neither of which the form holds as written. Not stated: interest on the account, a returned payment, the debit card's share on another currency, what opening asks.
